legal.privacyPolicy:
Data controller: Adrián Carrasco López. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Purpose: wedding invitation management, RSVP and event communication.

Legal basis: consent of the data subject (Art. 6.1.a GDPR). Health data (allergies and food intolerances) is processed with explicit consent (Art. 9.2.a GDPR) to adapt the wedding menu.

 Data collected: Expected guests list: the organizer may add a list of names (expected guests) for attendance tracking; this data is only visible to the organizer and follows the same retention policy.  Demonstrable consent: RSVP consent and cookie preferences are recorded with date and policy version. Access and audit: for security and traceability purposes (legitimate interest), attempts to access the organizer panel and configuration changes are logged (date, action type and technical device data).  name, dietary preferences (allergies and intolerances), voluntarily uploaded images, bank details if voluntarily provided, date of birth (only to validate age in the RSVP of minors), technical browser data (user-agent) when confirming attendance and, if you take part in the invitation's social features (notes, songs, rides, gift reservations), your name and the message you contribute, which are VISIBLE to the other guests.

Recipients: Google LLC (Firebase, Google Cloud Platform) based in the USA. Google has signed the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission (Implementing Decision 2021/914) and has a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) in accordance with Art. 28 GDPR. In addition, Google complies with the Data Privacy Framework (DPF) EU-US, UK-US and Switzerland-US, a certification that guarantees an adequate level of protection for international data transfers.

International transfers: data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Europe, Frankfurt). When data transfer to the US is necessary, it is covered by the SCC and Google's DPF certification.

Retention period: guest data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date. After this period, guest data is deleted by the service administrator (who has a cleanup action in their panel) and, in any case, is not retained for more than 12 months. You may also request earlier deletion. The creator's configuration data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date or while the account is active, whichever comes first; its deletion is carried out by the service administrator.

Rights: you may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Guests may request deletion of their data by providing their name and the invitation. We will respond to your request within a maximum of 30 days.

Right to withdraw consent: you may withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

Right to lodge a complaint: you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of your habitual residence, place of work or place of the alleged infringement.

Minors: we do not knowingly collect data from children under 14 years of age. If the data subject is under 14 (or the equivalent age under their country of residence: 14 in Spain, 16 in Germany, etc.), we require the consent of their parents or legal guardians.

Automated decisions: no automated decisions are made based on your data.

Consequences of not providing data: if you do not provide your personal data, we will not be able to manage your RSVP.

DPO: this website does not require a Data Protection Officer under Art. 37 GDPR, as the conditions of Art. 37.1 are not met. You may still contact the controller at any time.

Complaints under GDPR (EU/EEA): you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Authority (AEPD) or with the supervisory authority of your EU member state.

UK GDPR: for residents of the United Kingdom, the controller undertakes to comply with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Google complies with the UK Extension to the EU-US DPF, and the SCCs have been adopted by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) as a valid transfer mechanism. You may lodge a complaint with the ICO (https://ico.org.uk).

Local storage: this website uses local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) only for essential functions: keeping your session and caching the invitation configuration. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers without your consent or without your action: the map and translation only activate when you click them. By continuing to browse, you consent to this necessary technical storage.

CCPA/CPRA (California): If you are a California resident, you have the right to:
- Know what categories of personal information we collect and for what purpose.
- Request deletion of your personal information.
- Opt out of the sale of your personal information (we do not sell personal data).
- Not be discriminated against for exercising your CCPA rights.
To exercise these rights, write to adriancl2001@gmail.com.

LGPD (Brazil): If you are in Brazil, you have the rights under the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), including confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, blocking, deletion, portability, and revocation of consent. DPO: same data controller. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Rights under Art. 18 LGPD: confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/deletion, portability, information about sharing, withdrawal of consent, review of automated decisions, opposition.

PIPEDA (Canada): If you are in Canada, your personal information is handled in accordance with PIPEDA. PIPEDA principles: accountability (Adrián Carrasco López), identifying purposes, consent, limiting collection, limiting use/disclosure/retention, accuracy, safeguards, openness, individual access, challenging compliance. Mandatory breach notification to the OPC.

POPIA (South Africa): If you are in South Africa, you have the rights under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), including access, correction, deletion, and objection to processing. Conditions for cross-border transfers (Section 72 POPIA): data is transferred to Google LLC (USA) which provides an adequate level of protection through SCCs and DPF. The controller ensures the recipient applies processing principles similar to those of POPIA. You may lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator (South Africa).

Security breach response plan: in the event of a personal data breach, Wedingo will notify the competent supervisory authority within a maximum of 72 hours (GDPR Art. 33). If the breach poses a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, they will be notified without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). Notifications will be sent by email to the contact address provided.

Technical storage and cache (PWA): Wedingo uses a service worker (/sw.js) that precaches application resources (JavaScript, CSS and fonts) to speed up loading and enable basic offline use. These resources are stored in your browser cache on your device and contain no personal data. You can clear this cache from your browser settings at any time.

Analytics and error monitoring: with your consent ('Visit analytics' option), Wedingo uses Google Analytics (Google LLC) to measure anonymous usage of the invitation and Sentry (Functional Software, Inc., with DPA and Standard Contractual Clauses) to detect and fix errors. These services only receive data if you accept that option in the cookie banner; they never activate without consent. In addition, if the invitation includes a map, the Google Maps view is loaded only when you tap it (click-to-load): the map may set Google cookies only at that moment and as a result of your action. Translation: the 'Translate' feature uses the free Google widget (Google LLC) and only activates on user request; the invitation text is sent to Google only at that moment (processor covered by SCCs and DPF). Optional contact: if the guest authorizes it (specific checkbox), their phone or email is stored only for event logistics and is visible only to the organizer; they may request its deletion at any time.

envelope-flap.name: Envelope flap opening
envelope-flap.hint: On first tap the envelope flap opens with a 3D rotation. Turning it off opens the invitation directly with a single tap.

envelope-lights.name: Light halos around the envelope
envelope-lights.hint: Three golden halos orbit around the closed envelope, adding a warm glow.

envelope-flash.name: White flash on opening
envelope-flash.hint: A full-screen white flash lights the transition right after the flap opens.

envelope-golden-text.name: Golden welcome text
envelope-golden-text.hint: The golden message rises with a pulsing glow when the envelope opens and fades out on entry. Without it, that message is not shown.

envelope-hint-pulse.name: “Tap to open” text pulse
envelope-hint-pulse.hint: The helper text that explains how to open the envelope pulses softly to draw attention.

envelope-letter-fade.name: Inner letter fade
envelope-letter-fade.hint: The letter inside the envelope fades away when the flap opens to reveal the content.

envelope-overlay-fade.name: Envelope fade-out
envelope-overlay-fade.hint: When finished, the whole envelope fades out (opacity and blur) to reveal the invitation.

confetti-fall.name: Confetti shower on entry
confetti-fall.hint: 48 colorful pieces fall once behind the invitation on entry, as a celebration.

welcome-video-modal.name: Welcome video enter/exit
welcome-video-modal.hint: The frame where the welcome video plays appears and disappears with a smooth motion and fade.

decoration-sway.name: Eucalyptus branches sway
decoration-sway.hint: The decorative side branches sway softly, as if blown by the wind, throughout the invitation.

decoration-float.name: Branches floating
decoration-float.hint: A very subtle vertical motion of the decorative branches while you are in their section.

story-transitions.name: Section transitions
story-transitions.hint: On scroll, each section blurs, shifts and changes opacity depending on how close it is to the center of the screen.

story-reveal.name: 3D card entrance
story-reveal.hint: When the envelope opens, the first section enters with a small 3D rotation and blur that dissipates.

story-smooth-scroll.name: Smooth scrolling
story-smooth-scroll.hint: Scrolling between sections glides with a smooth acceleration instead of jumping abruptly.

story-snap.name: Section auto-centering
story-snap.hint: When you stop scrolling near a section, the invitation slides by itself to center it on screen.

story-hover.name: Section lift on hover
story-hover.hint: The active section lifts slightly with a shadow when you hover over it.

fireflies.name: Fireflies drifting
fireflies.hint: 20 fireflies with a light halo drift slowly across the background of the screen.

music-equalizer.name: Equalizer bars
music-equalizer.hint: Three bars move like an equalizer on the music button while the song plays.

music-fab-pulse.name: Music button pulse
music-fab-pulse.hint: A pulsing halo surrounds the floating music button while audio is playing.

music-card-open.name: Player opening
music-card-open.hint: The music player panel unfolds with a soft scale when you tap the button.

music-icon-bounce.name: Music icon bounce
music-icon-bounce.hint: The musical note icon bounces when you open or close the player.

music-fab-shift.name: Music button shift
music-fab-shift.hint: The floating button slides aside when the player opens so it does not cover it.

music-dot-blink.name: Music notification dot
music-dot-blink.hint: The dot that signals an error or the audio state blinks softly.

music-play-glow.name: Play button glow
music-play-glow.hint: The player's play/pause button emits a softly pulsing glow.

music-spinner.name: Music loading spinner
music-spinner.hint: A spinner rotates on the button while the song is loading.

music-fab-hover.name: Music button scale on hover
music-fab-hover.hint: The floating button grows slightly when you hover over it.

music-status-shake.name: Music error shake
music-status-shake.hint: The load-error message shakes to draw attention.

hero-photo-ring.name: Golden photo ring
hero-photo-ring.hint: A golden ring pulses around the couple's photo on the cover.

hero-godparent-glow.name: Godparents glow
hero-godparent-glow.hint: The text with the godparents' names emits a warm pulsing glow.

hero-photo-fade.name: Photo fade-in
hero-photo-fade.hint: The cover photo appears with a smooth fade once it finishes loading.

countdown-tick.name: Live countdown
countdown-tick.hint: The remaining-time counter updates every second. When off, the static initial value is shown.

loading-spinner.name: Loading spinners
loading-spinner.hint: The spinning wheels shown while the cover photo and other content load.

gallery-blur.name: Blurred photo change
gallery-blur.hint: When browsing the gallery, the previous photo blurs out while the new one comes in sharp.

gallery-caption.name: Photo caption entry
gallery-caption.hint: Each photo's description appears with a small upward slide.

gallery-lightbox.name: Photo viewer opening
gallery-lightbox.hint: The gallery's full-screen viewer appears with a fade-in.

gallery-thumb-hover.name: Thumbnail scale on hover
gallery-thumb-hover.hint: Gallery thumbnails grow slightly when you hover over them.

gallery-nav-hover.name: Gallery arrows scale on hover
gallery-nav-hover.hint: The gallery navigation arrows grow when you hover over them.

gallery-auto-advance.name: Automatic carousel advance
gallery-auto-advance.hint: The gallery advances every 5 seconds. When off, it only changes when you tap the arrows.

button-hover.name: Button lift
button-hover.hint: Invitation buttons (confirm RSVP, share, send...) lift slightly with a shadow on hover.

reaction-hover.name: Reactions scale on hover
reaction-hover.hint: The reaction buttons (❤️ 🎉 😂) grow slightly when you hover over them.

theme-glow-depth.name: Background glow
theme-glow-depth.hint: A light glow slowly sweeps the invitation background for a sense of depth.

landing-pulse.name: Loading screens pulse
landing-pulse.hint: The background of loading, error and maintenance screens pulses softly.

toast-animations.name: Floating notifications
toast-animations.hint: Brief notifications (confirmations, errors...) appear and disappear with a slide.

animations.allOffHint: When enabled, the invitation is shown with no animations: the envelope does not appear and there is no confetti or transitions. Disabling it restores your individual preferences.
